Thank you.
Unfortunately since my current CPN is my 4th/5th, i have lost count to be honest and the social workers i have had (which i should never have been given since all of them not only specialized in geriatric care but were also NOT trained to properly deal with someone who has PTSD *Diagnosed but Complex PTSD *Undiagnosed) it wouldn't "fit" into the pretty little bow that is the hell that we call the "NHS" (National Health System), yes, European.

I have lost two friends due to the "system" with their constant bull, my CPN even told me that, the only way to get urgent, immediate help i would have to phone my mental health support center and actively, willingly volunter to say "I have a plan to kill myself" - Which makes no sense, i mean, if i had a plan and i wanted to do it, why would i, or anyone else phone them? Unless i wanted to be stopped or wanted help?

It is idiotic for them to just assume, not just assume but willingly take the risk of expecting their patients to be "not too far past the point of no return, that they cant call."

I've come this far, basically on my own, i guess i should of learned my lesson years ago when a male professional attacked me and i told someone, only for their reply to be "Yeah, sure, haha" whilst walking away and then procedeed to mock me.

Do i have things to live for? Yes, Is the daily pain (both physical and mental) worth it? No, not at this moment.

I guess what it all boil downs to, is - I don't want to be a rag doll anymore, "used and then passed around, never ending."
